notes.title: Discover the Explorers Collection: The Oregon Trail & Carmen Sandiego Bundle
notes.notes: [h3]Made for Curious Minds![/h3][h3][/h3][p][b]The Explorers Collection[/b] brings together the recently released reinterpretations of The Oregon Trail and Carmen Sandiego.[/p][p][/p][p]Uncover mysteries across continents and brave the wild frontier in this premium bundle celebrating two of gaming's most iconic adventures.[/p][p][/p][p]Whether you're a seasoned sleuth, a trailblazing tactician, or a curious newcomer, the Explorers Collection is your passport to discovery.[/p]

notes.title: The Oregon Trail — Verified on Steam Deck
notes.notes:
[b]Attention all pioneers and trailblazers!🤠🌵🐎[/b] The journey west just got even more exciting with the news that [b]The Oregon Trail has been verified for Steam Deck[/b].🎉🎮

Whether you're a fan of the original game or a new player, The Oregon Trail offers a fun and educational experience as you journey west with your wagon and encounter various challenges along the way.🌄🐻 Now, with the Steam Deck, you can experience the game's iconic gameplay and nostalgic graphics on your portable device.

So grab your trusty wagon, gather your supplies, and embark on the adventure of a lifetime with The Oregon Trail on your Steam Deck.🎒🧑‍🌾🌅 It's time to experience the excitement and challenges of pioneer life, all from the palm of your hand. Happy trails!🤗👋

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/8ac928f2fc56824c2dba8a82195f41f104e7c2cb.png[/img]

notes.title: Journey through the Dark: Night Terrors on the Oregon Trail
notes.notes:
Welcome to "Night Terrors," 👻🌧️🌃 a weekly event where you must lead a party through the longest night. But it's not just any night – it's the rainy season, and your party members are terrified of the dark. The challenge is made even tougher as you start with an empty inventory and lose morale every night. So, are you ready to take on the challenge of "Night Terrors" and prove your pioneer spirit?  Who knows – you might just make it to the other side and become a trailmaster of the Oregon Trail. 🗺️🌲🏕️

Chat with fellow players, share tips and strategies, and make new friends on The Oregon Trail [url=https://discord.gg/theoregontrail-game]game-dedicated Discord server[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/1525ca2014681b32e79f11e885b3bf6ff42e423a.png[/img]

notes.title: Conquer the Ultimate Challenge on the Columbia River
notes.notes:
Are you up for a thrilling adventure on the Columbia River? 🚣‍♂️💨💦 With only one life, you'll need to stay sharp and focused as you navigate through the unpredictable twists and turns, mastering the reversed controls and ever-changing raft size. 

🧐🌀 Get ready to experience the ultimate challenge where every move counts! 

Chat with fellow players, share tips and strategies, and make new friends on The Oregon Trail [url=https://discord.gg/theoregontrail-game]game-dedicated Discord server[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/eb688f3e5638b5c39a2a3d35ba1ba1d5d8471bfc.png[/img]

🌬️🗺️ Discover the thrill of pioneering with "How the Wind Blows" — an exclusive weekly adventure like no other.

Experience the rugged California Trail aboard an experimental Wind Wagon, complete with a rigid inventory. 📝 Sign up today and let the wind guide your journey! 🌪️

notes.title: Get Your Hunting Game On with Hold Your Horses Time-Limited Event
notes.notes:
[h3]🎯🐗 Attention all hunters! [/h3]

Get your rifles primed, powder horns filled, and bullets at the ready for the ultimate hunting experience with the time-limited event - "Hold Your Horses"! 🐎💨 With animals that flee from gunshots and bullets that pierce through them, this is not the typical hunting game you got used to. Don't dally 🏃, claim your spot and take aim at the ultimate hunting challenge!

Connect with fellow hunters on our [url=https://discord.gg/theoregontrail-game]game-dedicated Discord server[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/0f9b089a0f62f1ed3c37dfcacd61a2391f8e2945.png[/img]

notes.title: Survive the Troubled Waters: A Time-Limited Challenge in The Oregon Trail
notes.notes:
[h3]Experience the ultimate test of survival skills at Pandemonium, a time-limited event that promises chaos and randomness.[/h3]

In this exciting journey, all character stats start at 1 and are randomized with every skill use. Members of your party are selected randomly, adding an extra challenge to the game. Pandemonium is a chaotic remix of the trail that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Don't miss this event and join the adventure of a lifetime!

Need a piece of advice to make your journey across The Oregon Trail easier? [url=https://discord.gg/theoregontrail-game][b]Join us on Discord[/b][/url] and connect with a vibrant community of fellow pioneers who are ready to share their knowledge and experience with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/25323752c0a4bd9d0a547e2c4e76de04c6cb052c.png[/img]

notes.title: Survive the Troubled Waters: A Time-Limited Challenge in The Oregon Trail
notes.notes:
[h3]Get ready to brave the elements in a new challenge: an unstable raft that's drifting toward the shore. [/h3]

[b]Will you be able to navigate the rough waters and reach the highest score?[/b]

But that's not all. The screen will randomly go dark, leaving you stranded in the wilderness with limited visibility. And to make matters even more challenging, it's always raining. If you're up for the challenge, join us on the trail and connect with other players on our [b][url=https://discord.gg/theoregontrail-game]game-dedicated Discord server[/url][/b]. Share your progress, strategies, and high scores, and see how you stack up against other adventurers. 

[previewyoutube=os8JHMNQOks;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Welcome to Attrition — the ultimate test of survival in The Oregon Trail!
notes.notes:
In this time-limited event, every decision counts, and every misstep may become the last one.

[b]Do you have what it takes to endure the harsh realities of pioneer life?[/b]

In Attrition, your party will face a new level of challenge as health cannot be restored once lost. That's right, every injury, illness, and ailment will linger until it's too late. But don't despair! Your party can recover their stats at forts along the way, so use them wisely and stock up on supplies. Don't miss out on this unforgettable adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/993a0b7738e842638bde209607bc04d6b7867da5.png[/img]

[b]Join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/theoregontrail-game]game-dedicated Discord server[/url] to share your progress with fellow travelers and discuss strategies to survive this grueling journey. Let's see who can make it to the end![/b]

notes.title: Unleash the Touch of Death!
notes.notes:
[b][h3] Can you rag-doll yourself into the hunting hall of fame?[/h3][/b]
Use your rifle to launch yourself around the wilderness and bag animals by touching them. 

[i]Modifiers:[/i]
● Firing your weapon launches you in the opposite direction.
● Touching animals kills them.
● Animals are immune to bullets.

[previewyoutube=-kPkeToVfgA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: An Unforgettable Journey
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Every gamer knows, a great adventurer always has guts, talent, and inexplicable amnesia.[/h3][/b]

So this week's challenge puts you in charge of a party so forgetful, they don't even know their own stats!

This is sure to be a trek to remember.


[i]Modifiers:[/i]
● All waypoints are revealed from the start.
● Waypoints are hidden after being encountered.
● Character stats are always hidden.

[previewyoutube=uRCRJuICBlM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Withstand the Chill to Avoid a Spill
notes.notes:
[b][h3]You've tried fording and rafting the river, but you've never tried skating it![/h3][/b]
Keep your cool as your wagon slips and slides along the river in this icy challenge!

[i]Modifiers:[/i]
● The raft drifts towards the shore.
● The controls are reversed.
● It's snowing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/808cbf56b4f1d1271ad5daa15ef7cfada70bed2c.png[/img]

notes.title: A Ragtag Trek to Cali
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Some pilgrims just aren't cut out for The Oregon Trail.[/h3][/b]
We call them, “Californians.” Help a party of terrible adventurers crawl their way across The California Trail before they get themselves killed.

[i]Modifiers:[/i]
● All party members have terrible stats.
● All party members are Adventurers.
● The party is stuck at Grueling and Bare Bones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/9e4776640a78def7e08b8497ecaca6f6c0bf72a5.png[/img]

notes.title: Don't Move, Take Aim, and Score Big!
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Massive animals have been discovered in a lost corner of the map![/h3][/b]
But these jumbo beasts have sharp ears, and they'll startle at your every move. Take on this new Special Contract and bag yourself “The Big Bucks.”

[i]Modifiers:[/i]
- Animals are giant.
- Moving reduces your score.
- Each shot spends points (instead of bullets).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/5f13779fd15e285fbad642d5d522446023c89ed8.png[/img]

notes.title: Feed Your Appetite for Adventure with this Weekly Challenge
notes.notes:
[h3]Escorting this party of hungry hungry pilgrims will require more food than your wagon can handle! [/h3]Luckily, you've got more than enough ammo and an especially bountiful hunting ground to keep the feasts flowing in this new Special Contract, “Gluttony.”

[i]Modifiers:[/i]
- Characters consume three times as much food.
- Hunting yields triple the food and pelts.
- The party has unlimited bullets.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/1ad44cb53fe4997101235674f88082a1e719390d.png[/img]

notes.title: How Long Can You Stay Afloat?
notes.notes:
[h3]You're up the creek without a paddle in this Special Contract.[/h3]

Brave the mighty Columbia River as long as possible while trying to steer your raft as little as possible. But even a single slip-up can mean you're sunk in “One False Move.”

[b]Modifiers:[/b]
- Your raft has only one life.
- You lose points for moving left or right.
- Damage to your raft is repaired every few yards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/c2605fa48b01bd114cfcefdb55274285babf7a93.png[/img]

notes.title: Dare to Travel this Treacherous Trail?
notes.notes:
[h3]Some paths are so perilous, they're only traveled by those brave enough, strong enough, or lost enough to take them on.[/h3]

See if you can survive such hardships in the new Special Contract, “Chronic Conditions.”

[b]Modifiers:[/b]
- All characters start with max stats.
- Random stat increases become decreases instead.
- Status effects can't be removed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/898f596b54f44cd3205be4c032d091baf68a4af9.png[/img]

notes.title: Go on a Hunting Spree in This Week's Special Event
notes.notes:
[h3]Everyone's a marksman when hunting a giant buffalo.[/h3]

But can you handle swarms of itty-bitty critters moving at lighting fast speeds?

Then set your sights on the Special Contract, “Swarm Regards” and prove yourself a master hunter!

[b]Modifiers:[/b]
- Hunting mini-game has three times as many animals.
- Animal speed is greatly increased.
- All animals are tiny.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/e3c5a5dcd81aabd670446b18acad66d13d7febce.png[/img]

notes.title: Play Tips #2: Shopping
notes.notes:
[h3]Buying the right supplies can make a huge difference to your chance of survival.[/h3]

[h3]There's a variety of goods for sale at forts, think carefully about what you need.[/h3]

[h3]Don't spend all your money in one place, you might need it later.[/h3]

[img]https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-2/Tip02_ImageA.png[/img]

[h3]Think carefully about your choice of wagon, you won't be going anywhere without it![/h3]

[h3]Your choice of wagon determines how many oxen you'll be bringing.[/h3]

[img]https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-2/Tip02_ImageB1.png[/img]

[h3]It's always a good idea to purchase food and ammunition before you depart.[/h3]

[img]https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-2/Tip02_ImageB2.png[/img]

[h3]Keep your wagon in good repair by purchasing toolboxes, grease, and spare parts.[/h3]

[img]https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-2/Tip02_ImageB3.png[/img]

[h3]Keep a supply of medicine for emergencies, it could save your life![/h3]

[img]https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-2/Tip02_ImageB4.png[/img]

[h3]Fresh clothes are perfect for keeping your party warm and clean.[/h3]

[img]https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-2/Tip02_ImageB5.png[/img]

[h3]Need a stamina boost? Try giving your party some coffee.[/h3]

[img]https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-2/Tip02_ImageB6.png[/img]

We are happy to announce the release of December’s 1.0.8 Hotfix for The Oregon Trail.
Please see the detailed list of what to expect from the patch below:

notes.title: Play Tips #1: Party Drafting
notes.notes:
[h3]When you're drafting a party, make sure to select a [i]combination of different classes.[/i][/h3]

[h3]Every character has their own combination of traits, both good and bad.[/h3]
 
[h3]You may discover unique outcomes based on the traits of your characters.[/h3]

[h3]Every class has a special item that they bring with them.[/h3]


[img]https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-1/Tip01_ImageA.jpg[/img]

[h3]Remember to give your party [i]a mixture of different strengths[/i].[/h3]

[h3]You can rename your party after drafting them. Try naming them after your friends![/h3]

[img]https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-1/Tip01_ImageB1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/053b64af434b3f9a57bce94a47b4c200fe7ed194.png[/img]

[h3]There's a diverse selection of characters to pick from, choose who you like best.

You can unlock new classes by playing the game and completing journeys.

You'll have new characters to choose from every time you play.[/h3]

[img]https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-1/Tip01_ImageC.png[/img]
